edges.note: 'The trick would be, I think, to describe the project so that, to the public, it would appear a totally objective study but, to the scientific community, would present the image of a group of nonbelievers.'

edges.label: Both official studies buried an unexplained residue under dismissive conclusions
edges.note: SR14 left 19.7 per cent unknown with quality correlating positively with unexplainedness; the Colorado project left roughly a third of its cases unexplained. Both summaries declared the subject unrewarding.

edges.label: Low wrote the memo two months before the contract was signed
